t: Radical Diagnosability: Why I Chose HTMX Over the Hamster Wheel
s: The author rejects modern web development's complexity for HTMX and FastHTML, valuing simplicity, transparency, and radical diagnosability in his Pipulate project, while also exploring philosophical questions of AI and free will.
sub: Critique of modern web development complexity (JavaScript tooling, build processes)
HTMX and FastHTML as a simpler, Python-centric web development alternative
The role of Jupyter Notebooks and literate programming principles
Philosophical reflections on AI intelligence, free will, and quantum mechanics
Pipulate project as a practical application of these principles
